socket.en: The lamp would not work because the socket was loose.
socket.zh: 檯燈無法使用，因為插座鬆了。

soda.en: The café offers juice, tea, and soda with lunch.
soda.zh: 這間咖啡館午餐時供應果汁、茶和汽水。

sofa.en: We moved the sofa closer to the living room window.
sofa.zh: 我們把沙發移得更靠近客廳窗戶。

soft.en: The blanket felt soft and warm on the cold night.
soft.zh: 寒冷的夜裡，那條毯子摸起來柔軟又溫暖。

soften.en: A kind explanation can soften criticism during a difficult conversation.
soften.zh: 在困難的對話中，友善的說明可以讓批評較不尖銳。

software.en: The school installed new software on every library computer.
software.zh: 學校在每台圖書館電腦上安裝了新軟體。

soil.en: Healthy soil helps vegetables grow well in the school garden.
soil.zh: 健康的土壤有助於校園菜園裡的蔬菜良好生長。

solar.en: The science club built a small solar car for the fair.
solar.zh: 科學社為科展製作了一輛小型太陽能車。

soldier.en: The museum displays letters written by a soldier during wartime.
soldier.zh: 博物館展示一名士兵在戰時寫下的信件。

solemn.en: The ceremony became solemn when everyone observed a moment of silence.
solemn.zh: 大家默哀時，典禮氣氛變得莊重。

solid.en: The table has a solid wooden frame that feels very sturdy.
solid.zh: 這張桌子有堅固的木製框架，感覺很牢靠。

solidarity.en: Students showed solidarity by helping classmates after the flood.
solidarity.zh: 學生透過協助水災後的同學展現團結。

solitary.en: A solitary tree stood in the middle of the wide field.
solitary.zh: 一棵孤單的樹立在寬廣田野中央。

solitude.en: She enjoyed the solitude of the library before classes began.
solitude.zh: 上課前，她享受圖書館裡的寧靜獨處。

solo.en: He performed a short piano solo at the school concert.
solo.zh: 他在學校音樂會上演奏了一段鋼琴獨奏。

sometime.en: We should visit the new science museum sometime this month.
sometime.zh: 這個月我們找個時間去新科學博物館吧。

somewhat.en: The second chapter was somewhat harder than the first one.
somewhat.zh: 第二章比第一章稍微難一些。

somewhere.en: I left my notebook somewhere near the reading area.
somewhere.zh: 我把筆記本忘在閱讀區附近的某個地方。

son.en: The farmer taught his son how to care for the orchard.
son.zh: 農夫教兒子如何照顧果園。

song.en: The choir practiced the same song several times after school.
song.zh: 合唱團放學後把同一首歌練習了好幾次。

soon.en: The rain stopped, and the sky soon became bright again.
soon.zh: 雨停後，天空很快又亮了起來。

soothe.en: Quiet music can soothe nervous students before a performance.
soothe.zh: 安靜的音樂可以讓表演前緊張的學生平靜下來。

sophomore.en: As a sophomore, she joined the school's debate team.
sophomore.zh: 高二時，她加入了學校辯論隊。

sore.en: His shoulders felt sore after carrying books all afternoon.
sore.zh: 搬了一下午的書後，他的肩膀感到痠痛。

sorrow.en: The novel explores sorrow after a family leaves its hometown.
sorrow.zh: 這本小說探討一個家庭離開故鄉後的悲傷。

sorrowful.en: The final scene has a sorrowful mood but ends with hope.
sorrowful.zh: 最後一幕氣氛哀傷，但以希望作結。

sorry.en: She said sorry after realizing that her comment was unfair.
sorry.zh: 她發現自己的話不公平後說了對不起。

sort.en: Please sort the worksheets by class before placing them away.
sort.zh: 收起講義前，請先按照班級分類。

soul.en: The poem uses the word soul to express a person's inner life.
soul.zh: 這首詩用 soul 一詞表達一個人的內在世界。

sound.en: A strange sound came from the old air conditioner.
sound.zh: 舊冷氣機傳出一個奇怪的聲音。

soup.en: The cafeteria served warm soup on the rainy afternoon.
soup.zh: 下雨的下午，學校餐廳供應熱湯。

sour.en: The lemon tasted sour even after we added some water.
sour.zh: 即使加了些水，檸檬喝起來仍然很酸。

south.en: The train travels south along the coast before turning inland.
south.zh: 火車沿海岸向南行駛，之後才轉往內陸。

southern.en: The southern part of the island receives warmer weather in winter.
southern.zh: 這座島的南部在冬季天氣較溫暖。

souvenir.en: She bought a small souvenir from the museum gift shop.
souvenir.zh: 她在博物館禮品店買了一個小紀念品。

sovereign.en: The textbook explains how a sovereign state manages its own affairs.
sovereign.zh: 課本說明主權國家如何管理自己的事務。

sovereignty.en: The lesson introduces sovereignty as an important idea in international relations.
sovereignty.zh: 課堂把主權介紹為國際關係中的重要概念。

sow.en: Farmers sow seeds in spring when the soil becomes warmer.
sow.zh: 春天土壤變暖時，農民會播種。

soybean.en: The farm grows soybean plants beside fields of corn.
soybean.zh: 這座農場在玉米田旁種植大豆。

spacecraft.en: The spacecraft sent new images back to scientists on Earth.
spacecraft.zh: 太空船把新的影像傳回地球給科學家。

spaceship.en: The story follows a spaceship traveling toward a distant planet.
spaceship.zh: 故事描述一艘太空船前往遙遠行星。

spacious.en: The new library is spacious enough for several study areas.
spacious.zh: 新圖書館很寬敞，可以容納好幾個學習區。

spade.en: The gardener used a spade to turn the soil carefully.

spaghetti.en: The cafeteria served spaghetti with vegetables for lunch today.
spaghetti.zh: 學校餐廳今天午餐供應蔬菜義大利麵。

span.en: The bridge has a long span across the wide river.
span.zh: 這座橋有一段很長的跨度跨越寬廣河面。

spare.en: I keep a spare notebook in my backpack for emergencies.
spare.zh: 我在背包裡放一本備用筆記本以防萬一。

spark.en: One interesting question can spark a lively classroom discussion.
spark.zh: 一個有趣的問題可以引發熱烈的課堂討論。

sparkle.en: Raindrops began to sparkle when the sun came out.
sparkle.zh: 太陽出來時，雨滴開始閃閃發亮。

sparrow.en: A sparrow built a nest beneath the school roof.
sparrow.zh: 一隻麻雀在校舍屋簷下築巢。

speaker.en: The guest speaker answered questions after the science lecture.
speaker.zh: 科學演講後，受邀講者回答了問題。
